nodes.label: run_bench.py benchmark runner
nodes.rationale: Scripted benchmark runs against the fork and API models; run-prompts generated per item x condition (blind gets the prompt verbatim; matched/heldout/uncovered wrap grounding files in REFERENCE MATERIAL markers).

nodes.label: Scorer layout contract
nodes.rationale: runs/<condition>/<system>/<ITEM>.md with exactly three path levels — the validate_golds.ipynb recalc cell hard-requires it. Preserve code fences verbatim (the 50 hand-pasted answers lost fences on copy, causing the kappa~0 calibration problem); non-.md sidecars are invisible to the scorer; never overwrite non-empty saved responses (0-byte scaffolds may be filled).

nodes.label: Fork adapter (headless in-process pipeline)
nodes.rationale: web_rag.py cannot be imported headless (module-top-level Streamlit, st.stop() without vect_store), so the answer pipeline is composed from pure parts — rag.py load/build functions plus advisor_room — exactly as the m2_smoke.py and eval_m4.py half-precedents do. Runs condition blind because the fork does its own retrieval; feeding it reference material would double-feed.

nodes.label: manifest.json provenance record
nodes.rationale: Per-run record of adapter, system, condition, model+params, timestamps, host, per-item statuses, and sha256 content hashes of the item bank, benchmark grounding, advisor grounding corpus, and snapshot. Content hashes stand in for git SHAs because the parent repo has no commits; the fork's HEAD ab01b54 carries a dirty-diff hash for the uncommitted advisor integration.

nodes.label: anthropic/openai API adapters (dry-run only)
nodes.rationale: Model strings and params pinned in bench_config.yaml with exponential-backoff retries, but code-only for now: no API keys configured, never executed against the paid APIs, only --dry-run exercised — user decision, zero spend. A production-stub adapter name is reserved and refuses to run.
